Dispute resolution

02

We are neither willing nor obliged to take part in dispute resolution proceedings before a consumer arbitration board (§ 36 (1) no. 1 VSBG).

The European Commission's online dispute resolution platform was shut down on 20 July 2025. The reference to it is therefore dropped. For cross-border disputes, the European Consumer Centre Germany can help.
